scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Saturday’s footwear follow-up able to include the planned work-shift insole comparison, not only a general check-in.
Emerging Need: The visit depends on recent service-shift comfort notes, and the usable note set is absent before the only qualifying shifts occur.
Decision Context: Saved podiatry guidance defines what counts as a useful note and why older recollections do not substitute; current schedule and household updates show the narrow collection window.
Consequence: If the first qualifying shift passes without a note, the missing record set cannot be completed in time, though the appointment itself has not begun.

parameter.title: Podiatry footwear follow-up
parameter.description: Routine follow-up for black service shoes and orange support insoles; include work-shift examples if available.

parameter.subject: Footwear follow-up prep for May 9
parameter.body: For Saturday's footwear follow-up, the clinician can include the planned work-shift insole comparison if you bring recent passenger-service comfort notes by Friday, May 8 at 6:00 PM. Without those notes, the visit remains a routine check-in.

parameter.title: Passenger service: Quincy extra
parameter.description: Confirmed long passenger-service assignment with outdoor platform boarding at Chicago, Galesburg, and Quincy; black service shoes required.

parameter.title: Passenger service: Milwaukee turns
parameter.description: Confirmed long passenger-service assignment with repeated outdoor platform boarding in Chicago and Milwaukee; black service shoes required.
parameter.location: Chicago Union Station and Milwaukee Intermodal

parameter.content: While sorting the hall travel bin, I checked the shoe-care notebook and the insole pouch. There are no April or May end-of-shift foot-comfort notes in either place, just blank pages and the spare laces.

parameter.subject: Quincy extra post-shift note window closed
parameter.body: The post-shift personal note window for the May 4 Quincy extra closed at 10:15 PM. No foot-comfort or footwear note was saved for that assignment.
